Apply the Overnight Price Feed

HardPro

The store keeps one current price per product in product_prices (product, price, updated_at; one row per product). Overnight, suppliers sent price_feed (feed_id, product, price, updated_at). Both tables are only here: look at them first.

Apply the feed to product_prices:

- a product that product_prices does not have yet gets a row;
- a feed row replaces a stored price only if its updated_at is later than the stored one; a row stamped the same time or earlier changes nothing;
- when the feed has several rows for one product, the latest one is the price that should end up stored (if it is newer than what is stored).

The store's updated_at must say when the stored price was set. Graded on product_prices after your statements run, on a fresh copy each attempt.
